MATLAB.name: MATLAB
MATLAB.description: Generates and submits MATLAB jobs (single node, optional parallel pool and GPU). Manage mode like Generic: workflow actions, job/node picker, a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU monitoring chart, processes) and logs.
MATLAB.author: Marinus Pennings

tamulauncher.name: tamulauncher
tamulauncher.description: Runs a large number of sequential or multi-threaded commands (one per line in a commands file) in a single job, spread over one or more nodes. Manage mode like Generic: workflow actions, a command progress card, job/node picker, a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU monitoring charts, processes) and logs.
tamulauncher.author: Marinus Pennings

Generic.name: Generic
Generic.description: Generic Slurm environment that should work on any cluster running Slurm. Shared create/manage pages, common Slurm parameters, module picker, workflow actions (rerun/cancel), job/node picker, a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU monitoring chart, processes) and logs.
Generic.author: Marinus Pennings

AlphaFold.name: AlphaFold
AlphaFold.description: AlphaFold 2 (ParaFold full_dbs or reduced_dbs) and AlphaFold 3 structure prediction, run as a CPU job (MSA) followed by a GPU job. Manage mode shows the Slurm jobs, pipeline timeline, logs, results summary, PAE / structure viewers, download bundle and a GPU-stage re-run.
AlphaFold.author: Marinus Pennings

LAMMPS.name: LAMMPS
LAMMPS.description: Analyzes a LAMMPS input file, suggests compatible LAMMPS modules and acceleration strategies, and generates the batch job. Manage mode shows a status strip, a run report, live charts of YAML thermo output, a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU monitoring chart, processes) and logs. Currently only available on the TAMU ACES cluster.
LAMMPS.author: Richard Lawrence

Python.name: Python
Python.description: Sets up a Python environment (module, private, new or shared virtual env, managed with ModuLair) and runs a Python script. Shared create/manage pages like Generic: Slurm checks, workflow actions, job/node picker, a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU monitoring chart, processes) and logs.

R.name: R
R.description: Generates and submits R jobs (R_tamu versions per cluster, optional SOCK/MPI/other parallel cluster or many runs of the script with tamulauncher, threads per R process for multithreaded math; the preview checks the script for missing packages and parallel mistakes). Manage mode like Generic: workflow actions, job/node picker, an R Run Check card (workers or run progress, failed runs, too many threads, common R errors explained, next-run advice), a Job Resources card (sstat/seff, CPU monitoring chart, processes) and logs.
R.author: Marinus Pennings

PyTorch-Lightning.name: PyTorch-Lightning
PyTorch-Lightning.description: PyTorch Lightning training jobs using the cluster Lightning module. Single and multi-GPU, DataLoader-based CPU sizing, TensorBoard and a training dashboard.

WorkflowHistory.name: WorkflowHistory
WorkflowHistory.description: Browse, rerun and delete the workflows of all environments recorded in the Drona database.
